summary.text: Consuelo Hernandez, a Democrat, is the incumbent state representative for Arizona House District 21 and a candidate for the seat in 2026.

paragraphs.text: In her 2024 Citizens Clean Elections candidate statement, she said she graduated from Sunnyside High School and, after graduating from Arizona State University with a degree in Global Health, mentored at-risk youth and spent over a decade working on education equity in Pima County.
The statement also describes her as president of the Sunnyside Union School District school board.

sources.title: Tucson Now: Consuelo Hernandez’s plan for District 21
